title: Required certificate witnesses may be omitted
detail: Supplied-record loops do not consistently assert the complete required witness set. In source59 an empty modular list skips all field-rank checks despite the final verified message. Source5 can process no minors; source11 omits direct-sum/sign coverage checks; source73 verifies a count but not its expected size/prime set. Actual supplied certificate omission was not established.

title: General scan-order capacity is unweighted
detail: construct_witness returns rank-one trace_witness capacity/gap even when called with r>1. Independent identity-layout control k9,t2,r2 gives62 emitted versus124 weighted capacity; listed generator/main examples use r1 and underlying theorem need not fail.

title: Operation ledgers omit executed arithmetic/tests
detail: Orbit-union reconstruction uses uncharged multiplication per active input entry. Phase6 omits sum-of-terms additions and root/inversion arithmetic. Phase8 omits bare root inversions and some zero/branch tests. Scale-audit all-mode activity is hardcoded. Asymptotic family bounds may survive but totals are not fully charged end-to-end costs.

title: Replay comparison does not establish fresh generation
detail: Paid-shears replay copies baseline result JSON into temporary directory before running checker. A zero-exit no-write checker can leave the same bytes and satisfy comparison. Source78 avoids this particular flaw by not copying result files.

title: Packager reruns may stale-hash and duplicate manifest
detail: Existing MANIFEST.json is inventoried and hashed before rewrite, then appended again to files for ZIP. Synthetic independent control confirms stale digest and two manifest entries in that state.

title: Prototype accepts zero inverse denominator silently
detail: Prototype inv lacks a zero guard; weighted_packet_entry therefore returns zero at alpha^n=1 rather than rejecting the undefined resolvent. Source70 uses zero-checking finite_field.inv and does not retain this particular silence.

title: Public function boundaries are wider than valid derivation
detail: Phase8 n=K=M=1 passes preliminary dimension checks then indexes tab[m] out of range. Weyl character packet permits n2 through prime-index helper although the common denominator is valid for odd prime n; independent n2,p5,alpha2 control has a nonzero common guard and a singular literal Green denominator. Intended tested domains avoid these cases.
